description_en: Call the DescribeDcdnWafPolicyDomains operation to query the accelerated domain names that are protected by a specific Web Application Firewall (WAF) policy
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnWafPolicyDomains查询已接入指定WAF防护策略的加速域名
name: DescribeDcdnWafPolicyDomains

parameters.description_en: The ID of the mitigation policy. You can specify only one ID.
parameters.description_zh: 防护策略ID，仅支持单个输入。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the mitigation policy. You can specify only one ID
parameters.help_zh: 防护策略ID，仅支持单个输入

parameters.description_en: The page number. Default value: **1**. Valid values: **1** to **100000**.
parameters.help_en: The page number. Default value: **1**. Valid values: **1** to **100000**

parameters.description_en: The number of domain names to display on each page. Default value: **20**. Valid values: an integer from **1** to **500**.
